subject.title: fix(models): reject oversized piped auth input

question: Should model-auth commands intentionally reject piped secrets larger than 1 MiB before downstream validation?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it deliberately changes behavior for any existing automation that supplies unusually large piped input.

options.title: Accept the 1 MiB boundary
options.body: Merge the current focused limit, treating oversized model-auth stdin as unsupported and aligning it with the related Matrix CLI guard.

options.title: Choose a different documented limit
options.body: Pause for a maintainer-selected compatibility limit if 1 MiB is not appropriate for the longest supported auth payloads.

recommendation.title: Accept the 1 MiB boundary
recommendation.body: Merge the current focused limit, treating oversized model-auth stdin as unsupported and aligning it with the related Matrix CLI guard.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged adjacent stdin-cap implementation used as the proposed pattern.
